News at 11 cover art

Cat System Corp.’s 9/11 album: a VHS-degraded American flag in a rounded TV frame, with a Japanese obi strip down the left edge.

Source
Cat System Corp. on Bandcamp
Creator
Cat System Corp. (Jornt Elzinga)
Made
September 11, 2016 (Geometric Lullaby)
Style
Vaporwave (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Melancholic, eerie, nostalgic
Evidence
Inspected the 1200 × 1200 cover on the album’s Bandcamp page, in a scratchpad copy. Not stored. The creator’s name comes from the Commons file Cat System Corp. - News at 11 cassette artwork (flag only).jpg.jpg).
Reviewed
28 September 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

Wikipedia: “One vaporwave album that directly interrogates 9/11 is News at 11 (2016) by Cat System Corp.” The label is Geometric Lullaby; the release date is September 11, 2016. Wikipedia: Vaporwave; Wikipedia: News at 11).

Observed

  • A waving American flag, smeared and colour-shifted like a worn VHS frame, fills a rounded-rectangle screen shape on black.
  • NEWS AT 11 sits below in white, narrow, pixel-like capitals.
  • A white obi strip on the left carries vertical katakana, a small flag, CATCORP and LOCAL 11 WEATHER logos, track lists in serif capitals, and the Geometric Lullaby logo.

Why it belongs

It shows the style’s darker side: the same devices (Japanese packaging, broadcast artefacts) used for mourning instead of play. The obi strip imitates Japanese import records.

Borrow

Add a narrow vertical strip of small, dense label text beside a large image to imitate an import-record obi.
